description: Trained flyvis_known_ode on flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00, fold cv00, embedding dim 0, 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 35, one-step training, fp32, W_L1 1e-05, at model noise sigma 0, 0.05, 0.5 (experiment 15, arm kode, 15/15 runs landed). Panels a, c, e plot learned vs true synaptic weight over all 434,112 edges; 1,085 edges (0.25%) lie outside the [-1, 2] axes. Panels b, d, f show UMAP of per-neuron learned tau and V_rest plus incoming/outgoing weight mean, SD, minimum, maximum, standardised, coloured by ground-truth cell type. Panels g, i, k plot V_rest; h, j, l plot tau, each annotated with R2 and slope against the true value.
facts:
CAPTION: Known-ODE parameter recovery. Known-ODE models (the published runs, fold cv00, re-analysed with the current analysis code, experiment 15) on Flyvis-217 under three model noise regimes (σ = 0, 0.05, 0.5). (a, c, e) Learned against true synaptic weight ˆWij, one point per edge, all 434,112 edges (the Known-ODE learns W directly); 1,085 edges (0.25%) lie outside the [−1, 2] axes. (b, d, f) UMAP projection of the per-neuron feature vector the clustering accuracy is computed on (learned τ and V rest, with the mean, SD, minimum and maximum of the incoming and of the outgoing learned weights, standardised), coloured by ground-truth cell type. (g, i, k) Resting potentials V rest i . (h, j, l) Time constants τi. Each scatter is annotated with the R2 and slope of learned against true quoted in Tab. 1 (identity-line R2; for τ and V rest the inlier R2 with the all-neuron R2 in parentheses, outliers 
FACTS:
- experiment: 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- arm: kode
- runs: 15 of 15 landed
- cells: condition: flyvis_noise_free, flyvis_noise_005, flyvis_noise_05
- dataset: flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_known_ode
- embedding dim: 0
- model noise sigma: 0.0
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 35
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 1e-05
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
